g.text: IoT Based LED Chaser (Running Lights) - Complete Circuit Schematic
Standard Wiring: Arduino Uno R3, 8-Channel 5V Optocoupled Relay (Active-LOW), 8x 330Ω Resistors, 8x Green LEDs, 5V Active Buzzer
PC817 Optocouplers + Flyback Diodes + Songle SRD-05VDC-SL-C
Note: Relays provide galvanic isolation via internal PC817 optocouplers. The 9V 1A adapter ensures stable coil excitation current without Uno USB brownout.
